|available_pets= |image2= }} The '''Exclusive Pets Egg''' is located in the [[Exclusive Shop (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Shop]] in [[Pet Simulator 99]]. 2 eggs can be purchased for {{Robux}} 240, 8 eggs can be purchased for {{Robux}} 950, 33 eggs can be purchased for {{Robux}} 2,950, with 3 bonus [[Exclusive Card Pack (Pet Simulator 99)|Card Packs]] and 20 [[Exclusive Raffle (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Raffle]] Tickets, and 169 eggs can be purchased for {{Robux}} 14,500, with a bonus chance for a [[Huge Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|huge]] or [[Titanic Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|titanic]] pet from the current Exclusive Egg on-sale, 5 Card Packs, and 500 [[Exclusive Raffle (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Raffle]] Tickets. To ensure compliance with regulations concerning paid random items, eggs cannot be purchased if the player is located in Australia, Belgium, Netherlands, South Korea, or the UK (if the user is under 18).
